question: RK Narayan is the author of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Guide**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Guide** is a novel written by R.K. Narayan, one of India's most celebrated English-language authors.
 
• R.K. Narayan is known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.
 
• **The Guide** was published in 1958 and won the Sahitya Akademi Award for English in 1960.
 
• The novel was also adapted into a successful film in 1965, starring Dev Anand and Waheeda Rehman.
 
• The story revolves around the life of Raju, a tour guide who undergoes a transformation in his life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• R.K. Narayan's writing style is marked by simplicity and subtle humor.
 
• He was one of the first Indian writers in English to achieve international recognition.
 
• His other notable works include **Swami and Friends, The Bachelor of Arts,** and **The Man-Eater of Malgudi.**
 
• R.K. Narayan was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1964 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2000 for his contributions to literature.
